prompt:
Create one native high fidelity illustrated 2D fighting-game sprite atlas of OLD SNAKE from the ORIGINAL Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots (2008 PLAYSTATION 3), matching the supplied actual original-game screenshots, not another Snake incarnation, not Touch or Portable Ops. Closest possible 1:1 original visible costume and equipment. Original aged, lean athletic elderly man, pronounced face wrinkles, thick GRAY MOUSTACHE, no beard, swept-back gray hair with longer gray nape, dark gray tied bandana and two short tails. Fitted dark charcoal / gray segmented OctoCamo suit, sculpted padded dark shoulders, charcoal chest panels with gray textured stretch mesh at upper arms and side torso, gray fitted trousers and dark knee reinforcement, dark combat boots reaching lower shin, entirely black tactical gloves. Original TAN / BROWN tactical webbing harness and modest pouches across chest, tan waist belt and tan crossed rear straps, no modern plate carrier or huge backpack. Solid Eye is a small BLACK ELECTRONIC MONOCULAR covering ANATOMICAL LEFT eye only, with slim black temple strap; the anatomical RIGHT eye is bare. This is not a pirate eyepatch and never migrates to right eye. Keep optic anatomically correct even when facing direction changes: near-side LEFT profile can show it clearly, RIGHT profile may hide some left optic beyond the nose. Dark bandana sits above optic, both distinct. No neon laser, optic powers, magic, aura, facecamo mask, modern redesign or prosthetic limbs. Keep the original proportions and elderly face, no generic young gray-haired soldier. Neutral matte muted original gray/tan palette (source camouflage pattern in other captures does not change the chosen baseline gray suit). Crisp detailed restrained hand-painted 2D sprite art with clean contour and consistent lighting. Native true transparent RGBA PNG, no background, ground shadows, checkerboard, text, labels, cell borders or disconnected props. Prefer wide 1536 x 1024 native image, exactly FOUR equally spaced COLUMNS by THREE ROWS = TWELVE separate complete full-body single-figure poses in row-major order. Each complete body with hair, hands, feet and all attached equipment fully inside its own cell, leave broad empty-alpha gutters and outer margins. One adult man per cell, no duplicate bodies or opponent. Homogeneous upright body scale; crouches and jumps bend limbs rather than enlarging heads or torsos.
All figures face SCREEN LEFT, mild side/three-quarter front fighting projection. Camera sees his anatomical LEFT cheek and the black Solid Eye lens with its slim temple strap covers this near LEFT eye. Right eye remains bare on far side. Original broad SILVER GRAY MOUSTACHE visible, no beard, bandana above eyebrows. All 12 figures remain original Old Snake, never mirror RIGHT images. SHEET B EXACTLY 12 DISTINCT POSES, 4 columns by 3 rows row-major. TOP ROW cell0 close CQC jab startup, right fist drawn near chest; cell1 jab active right black-gloved fist extended toward facing direction, other fist close; cell2 jab recovery withdrawing fist; cell3 heavy strike startup lifting rear elbow near shoulder. MIDDLE ROW cell4 heavy ACTIVE elbow/forearm strike across front toward facing direction, torso braced, ONE whole man NO opponent; cell5 heavy recovery drawing elbow close; cell6 low sweep startup crouching deeply with weight on planted boot; cell7 low sweep ACTIVE forward boot extended low toward facing direction, crouched torso and glove balance. BOTTOM ROW cell8 low sweep recovery retracting sweeping boot, knees still bent; cell9 hit reaction shoulders recoil away from facing direction and head rocks slightly, eye anatomy unchanged; cell10 KO fall knees buckling backward with both hands out, all body stays inside cell; cell11 KO fully lying on back/side, horizontal man, head and boots entirely inside cell, original face still recognizable. No weapon in hands, compact original hip holster only. All fists/arms anatomically plausible, no supernatural energy, muzzle flashes, projectiles or detached props. Maintain body scale: do NOT stretch horizontal KO or inflate crouching torso to fill cell.
